Smallest framework step: Dropwizard 2.0.17 -> 3.0.4 (still javax; ships logback 1.4, an SLF4J-2 provider). The minimal logback-only fix fails because logback 1.3 removed JMXConfigurator used by Dropwizard 2.0. Developer fix was Dropwizard 2 -> 4 (f10bef101d). Attempt 2 adds the Dropwizard 3 package move (io.dropwizard.{Application,Configuration,ConfiguredBundle,setup,server,cli} -> io.dropwizard.core.*) in 10 source files. Attempt 1 (POM only) failed to compile. Attempt 3 also removes the unused import io.dropwizard.Bundle (class removed in Dropwizard 3; it was referenced only in Javadoc). Attempt 4 adds junit:junit 4.13.2 (test): Dropwizard 3 testing no longer brings JUnit 4 transitively. Attempt 5 adds org.junit.vintage:junit-vintage-engine (version from the Dropwizard 3 BOM): attempt 4 compiled but ran 0 tests (JUnit 4 tests not discovered on the JUnit Platform). Attempt 6: vintage engine pinned to 5.9.3, the JUnit 5 version Dropwizard 3.0.4 uses (attempt 5 failed: version missing). Attempt 7 removes the jackson-databind 2.10.5.1 pin from dependencyManagement (the developer removed it too): attempt 6 ran the 16 tests but failed with Jackson NoClassDefFoundError.
